name: Connect_Disconnect_Sound_Alert
summary: This EA monitors the terminal's connection status to the trade server and triggers sound alerts when the connection is established or lost. It tracks connection/disconnection timestamps but has all sound playback logic commented out, making it currently non-functional as an alert system.
summary_zh: 该EA监控终端与交易服务器的连接状态，在连接建立或断开时触发声音警报。它记录连接/断开的时间戳，但所有声音播放逻辑已被注释掉，目前作为警报系统并不起作用。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个连接状态监控工具。其核心概念是通过轮询CTerminalInfo.IsConnected()方法来检测终端与服务器的连接状态变化。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不进行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用。仓位管理和资金管理均不存在。该EA的策略逻辑是在OnInit()函数中使用while循环以1秒间隔持续轮询连接状态，当检测到状态变化时记录时间戳并（原本应）播放对应声音文件。然而，所有PlaySound()调用均被注释掉，导致实际上没有任何警报功能生效。此外，将阻塞式while循环放在OnInit()中是一个严重的设计缺陷，因为这会阻止EA正常初始化完成。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a connection status monitoring utility. Its core concept is polling CTerminalInfo.IsConnected() to detect changes in the terminal's connection to the trade server. Entry conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute any trades. Exit conditions are similarly not applicable. Position sizing and money management are completely absent. The EA's logic uses a blocking while loop inside OnInit() with a 1-second polling interval to continuously check connection status, recording timestamps when state changes occur and (originally) playing corresponding sound files. However, all PlaySound() calls are commented out, rendering the alert functionality entirely non-operational. Furthermore, placing a blocking while loop inside OnInit() is a severe design flaw since it prevents the EA from completing its initialization properly.

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: 首次运行标志，用于跳过首次状态变化的声音警报
parameters.description_en: First run flag to skip initial state change sound alert

parameters.name: Pre_IsConnected
parameters.description: 上一次连接状态布尔值

pros: 概念简单实用，连接监控对交易者有实际价值
使用CTerminalInfo封装类访问连接状态，符合面向对象设计
记录连接和断开时间戳，便于事后排查问题
pros_en: Simple and practical concept — connection monitoring has real value for traders
Uses the CTerminalInfo wrapper class to access connection status, following OOP design
Records connection and disconnection timestamps for post-incident troubleshooting
cons: 所有PlaySound()调用被注释掉，核心警报功能完全不工作
在OnInit()中放置阻塞式while循环是严重的架构错误，阻止EA正常初始化
OnTick()、OnDeinit()等必要回调函数完全缺失
声音文件资源声明也被注释掉，即使取消注释PlaySound也无法工作
Sleep(1000)在OnInit中循环占用线程，可能导致终端卡顿
cons_en: All PlaySound() calls are commented out, rendering the core alert functionality completely non-functional
Placing a blocking while loop inside OnInit() is a severe architectural error that prevents proper EA initialization
Essential callback functions like OnTick() and OnDeinit() are completely missing
Sound file resource declarations are also commented out, so even un-commenting PlaySound would not work
Sleep(1000) inside an OnInit loop occupies the thread and may cause terminal unresponsiveness
improvements: 将连接监控逻辑从OnInit()移至OnTick()或使用定时器事件(OnTimer())，避免阻塞初始化过程
取消注释并修复声音播放逻辑，同时正确声明资源文件或使用终端内置声音
improvements_en: Move connection monitoring logic from OnInit() to OnTick() or use OnTimer() events to avoid blocking the initialization process
Uncomment and fix the sound playback logic, and properly declare resource files or use terminal built-in sounds

risk_points: 该EA不进行任何交易操作，无资金风险
阻塞式OnInit循环可能导致终端响应迟缓，间接影响其他EA运行
risk_points_en: The EA performs no trading operations, posing no financial risk
The blocking OnInit loop may cause terminal sluggishness, indirectly affecting other EAs

summary_en: This EA monitors the terminal's connection status to the trade server and triggers sound alerts when the connection is established or lost. It tracks connection/disconnection timestamps but has all sound playback logic commented out, making it currently non-functional as an alert system.
